adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Immediately after, teammate calendars are appended with `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. Because of optional chaining, this is a no-op when `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, so the collected `teamDestinationCalendars` are silently dropped. This prevents the new per-host destination calendar path from being used in that scenario (and `createAllCalendarEvents` only enters the per-destination loop when `event.destinationCalendar && event.destinationCalendar.length > 0`).
